title: Hero Section Generator
description: Design a hero section — headline, subtext, CTAs, gradient background — with live preview and HTML/CSS output.
howto: Write your eyebrow, headline and subheadline.
Add primary and secondary CTA buttons with links.
Style the background gradient, text color and alignment.
Copy the code or download the self-contained hero.html.

faqs.q: Can I use a background image instead of a gradient?
faqs.a: The generator produces gradients; you can replace the background rule with your own background-image URL afterwards.
Yes — the headline uses clamp() sizing and the layout centers on all screens.

faqs.q: Can I embed it in an existing page?
faqs.a: Copy the markup and the <style> block. All classes are prefixed with hs- to avoid collisions.
Each CTA has its own URL field — fill it with the destination you want.
